evals.name: already-merged-terminal
evals.expected_output: PR is already merged. D6 short-circuits — all six gates report as passing, Verdict: DONE with mergedAt timestamp, no workers dispatched, no further action taken.
assertions: Output shows the six-gate checklist with D1 through D6 in order
All six gates show [x] passing
Verdict line reads 'Verdict: DONE' and includes a mergedAt reference
No Agent sub-agents are spawned for this PR
Only one gh pr view call is made

evals.name: parallel-fix-ci-and-docs
evals.prompt: Get this PR over the line: https://github.com/acme-corp/user-service/pull/89
evals.expected_output: D1 passes, D2 fails (lint + e2e red), D3 passes, D4 fails (no approval yet), D5 fails (body is 40 chars, no issue link), D6 fails. D2 and D5 are independent — both workers dispatched in the same turn as parallel Agent calls. D4 is dependent on D3 ✓ so the orchestrator requests reviewers inline. D6 not dispatched (D2/D5 still red).
assertions: D2 worker and D5 worker are spawned in the SAME assistant turn as parallel Agent tool calls
Workers receive the absolute path to their playbook in references/, not the playbook content
D6 is NOT attempted because its prerequisites are not met
D3 sequential transition is not run (D3 already passes)
Verdict line reads 'NOT DONE — waiting on: D2, D4, D5' (or equivalent listing the failed gates)
Dispatched line lists D2 and D5

evals.name: draft-pr-cannot-mark-ready-while-red
evals.expected_output: PR is draft with red CI. D1 passes, D2 fails, D3 fails, D4 fails, D5 passes, D6 fails. Dependency graph means D3 cannot be flipped until D2 is green. Orchestrator dispatches D2 worker only; D3 stays pending for the next tick.
assertions: D2 worker is dispatched
Orchestrator does NOT run `gh pr ready` because D2 is still failing
D4 worker is NOT dispatched because D3 has not yet passed
Verdict line reflects D2, D3, D4, D6 as still-failing gates
Dispatched line shows only D2

evals.name: all-green-orchestrator-merges
evals.expected_output: D1-D5 all pass, D6 is the only failing gate, mergeStateStatus is CLEAN. Orchestrator runs `gh pr merge <N> --squash --auto` inline (no worker), reports the action, next tick will see D6 pass.
assertions: Orchestrator runs gh pr merge inline, NOT as an Agent sub-agent
No worker is dispatched for D6
The merge command uses --squash --auto by default (or the user's stated preference)
Output reports the merge attempt and the verdict reflects D6 still pending until next tick

evals.name: self-approval-not-enough
evals.expected_output: reviewDecision is APPROVED but the only approving review's author.login matches the PR author. D4 must fail under the non-author-approver rule. D4 worker is dispatched to find missing reviewers; it surfaces the self-approval issue rather than silently accepting it.
assertions: D4 marked failing despite reviewDecision being APPROVED
Reason on D4 mentions self-approval or missing peer reviewer
D4 worker is dispatched (D3 already passes)
Worker does not nag reviewers via comments

evals.name: wip-label-respected-not-stripped
evals.expected_output: PR has a `wip` label and the author's latest comment says 'still working on the e2e tests, hold off'. D1 fails. D1 worker inspects context, decides the WIP marker is intentional, does NOT strip the label, and reports asking the user to confirm before progressing.
assertions: D1 worker is dispatched
Worker does NOT run gh pr edit --remove-label
Worker reports the author signal looks intentional and asks the user
No downstream worker (D3, D4) is dispatched because D1 still fails
